page.overview:
Who is Caladoria?

Grand Admiral Caladoria of Lothern is an High Elf admiral of great prestige.

Her resplendent gold-woven hair trails behind her, complementing the radiant hues of her purple and white admiral's uniform under the brilliant sun.

She was at the helm of one of the grandest fleets ever assembled from Lothern's harbors in recent memory, Grand Admiral Caladoria is flanked by the esteemed Archmage Galindorm and Prince Keldorim, her trusted second-in-command. Together, they lead their vessels on a mission to mete out justice upon a band of pirates from the Old World who have pillaged the shores of Ulthuan. Laden with ill-gotten gains, the pirates have sought refuge in the distant lands of Estalia and Araby.

Even Captain Granitebrow, the Dwarf captain of the Grimnir’s Revenge took part in the conflict, but is uncertain on which side he has launched its torpedoes.
